The Thessaloniki public prosecutor's office has initiated a preliminary investigation, among other things for the formation of a criminal organization and public incitement to violence and hatred. They set houses on fire, looted, and terrorized the residents. It was the climax of an antisemitic campaign that had been ongoing since 1928. Many Jewish families lost their homes. The parallels are unmistakable.
